== About ==
Living in central Lund in the south of Sweden.
QuakeWorld player since 1996, but not active online since 1998. Now studying and working part time.

I guess I am most famous for my location (.loc) files which I have made for about every single playable dm map around. It's great fun that probably 99% of all the Quakeworld players out there are using them, and that I set the standard! :) I have also made a teamplay config file for fuhquake which are/were more or less used by various clans, but I didn't have the energy updating it since the new version of fq got out. Somebody else made the efforts updating it though, which I am very thankful of! 
I attended QH-LAN 2003/2004 and 2007. I was one of the early players who were using fuhquake and since I've always liked messing around with teamplay config files, I made one which grew very popular back in the days. Like 70% of the top div1-clans were using my config file, many of them which I in real life installed on the players' computers at the QH-LANs. I also put together a sound pak-file, don't know if it's very used around, but heard someone were using it.
Trivia: I have a collection of 950+ qw-skins!

Else, I like girls, beer and parties!
